technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot 3.x as the foundation for the application, requiring Java 17+.
Adopt Spring Cloud for service discovery implementation (e.g., Consul or Eureka).
Leverage existing Spring XD / Spring Cloud Data Flow architecture for source/sink modules and job partitioning.
Use Docker Compose and Dockerfile for containerization, with CI integration using Jenkins.
For cluster deployment documentation, assume Mesos with Marathon as the target orchestrator.
Design partitioning strategy as a pluggable interface to allow custom strategies.
HDFS source module will use Hadoop client libraries and follow existing module patterns.
Commit-interval override to be implemented as a configurable property in servers.yml, applied globally for all OOTB jobs with partition support.
assumptions: The existing codebase provides a modular structure for source/sink modules, job definitions, and configuration files.
The development team is experienced with Spring Framework, Docker, and Mesos/Marathon.
All external dependencies (RabbitMQ, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, MongoDB) are available in test environments.
Documentation for U4 will be in Markdown format and included in the project repository.
Evaluation of Spring Boot dependency upgrades (U5) includes automated testing to detect regressions.
No additional effort is allocated for project management or non-development overhead.
CI infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins) is already set up and configured.

activities.activity_description: Detailed analysis of all user stories (U1-U8), creation of acceptance criteria, and clarification of ambiguous requirements.
Overall system design, integration points, data model changes, and technical decisions for implementing all features.
Extend container configuration to support linking/binding attributes and environment variables for Docker XD containers.
Integrate service discovery (e.g., using Spring Cloud Consul or Eureka) to allow Docker XD containers to find and talk to each other.

activities.activity_name: Implement CI Build for Docker Images (U3)
activities.activity_description: Create CI pipeline (e.g., Jenkinsfile) to build Docker images, run tests, and push images to a registry.
Write comprehensive documentation covering deployment of an XD cluster on Mesos with Marathon, including configuration files and recommendations.
Perform impact analysis of upgrading Spring Boot dependencies, run existing test suites, and document any side effects or needed changes.
Add a pluggable partitioning strategy interface and configuration option to allow users to supply custom partitioning for RDBMS to HDFS ingest jobs.
Develop a new source module to ingest data from HDFS file system, following existing module patterns and using Hadoop client libraries.
Add ability to override default commit-interval via servers.yml for all out-of-the-box jobs that support partition, and update job configuration parsing.
End-to-end testing of all new features together, fixing integration issues, and verifying correctness across components.
Peer review of all code changes, addressing feedback, performing code cleanup and optimization.
Package final release, update release notes, perform final verification, and prepare deployment artifacts.
